task.criterion: Realizacao conjunta de Maxwell e tensor de materia. Campos do certificado completo nao triviais na mesma rede; simetria/conservacao e fonte geometrica ligados.

component.purpose: First effective Bochner measure transport required by the actual Maxwell null-plane wave. It replaces no certificate and assumes no charge or transport equality.
component.fiber: dp/E -> rapidity -> du/u for positive transverse mass, using the existing smooth injective charts and Mathlib Bochner Jacobian theorem. The same constructions prove equivalences of integrability.
component.global: For any complete real normed target G and f : MomentumCoordinates -> G integrable under orbitalMeasure 0, the orbital Bochner integral equals the iterated integral dq du/u at nullMomentumCoordinates(q,u). Fubini is used only under the stated actual integrability.
component.cancellation: For f with (E-p) smul f integrable under orbitalMeasure 0, the orbital integral of (E-p) smul f equals integral dq integral_{u>0} f(q,(r(q)^2-u^2)/(2u)). The Jacobian weight is cancelled by proof using null_inverseLongitudinal.
component.domain: Fiber r>0; global r(q)=transverseMass 0 q, positive almost everywhere by canonical transverseMass_pos_ae. u is restricted to Ioi 0. The q=0 axis is handled as measure-zero; it is not removed by a new physical postulate.
component.target_instances: G=Complex or Fib are existing complete spaces; the generic theorem does not introduce a new physical Hilbert space.
component.no_vacuity_claim: Raw Bochner identities can be written without integrability because Lean totalizes the integral. The candidate includes fiber integrability equivalences and requires actual integrability for the global Fubini/cancellation formulas.
